description: This is a Java source file defining the KubeRenderer class, which implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface to render 3D graphics using OpenGL ES in an Android environment.

classes.name: KubeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer to render a 3D scene with OpenGL ES, including methods for setting up the scene, handling rendering frames, surface changes, and initialization.

methods.name: KubeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a world object and an optional animation callback.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame, clears buffers, sets transformations, and draws the 3D objects.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the surface, adjusting the viewport and projection matrix.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initial setup when the rendering surface is created; currently no special setup is needed.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle for the scene.
